question: Can the current Alia Das Specialist reach a supply of the Repair-O-Matic's required Power Cells without adding an unverified class-gear reward?
result: The current emulator world database stocks item template 56, class 3807, at the Ammo Supply Vendor Alia Das (creature 73, spawnpool 116) for 3 credits each. The Repair-O-Matic reward template 122871 uses weapon class 12797, whose preloader row names ammo class 3807 and a 10-round clip. Vendor purchase and weapon reload code paths match stocked class-3807 ammo placed in personal inventory slots 50-99. This identifies a potential ordinary emulator path to usable ammo; it has not been exercised in the compatible client, and none of these emulator rows proves final-live vendor stock or mission ammo grants.

current_world_database.read_only_query: SELECT c.id,c.comment,s.id,s.pos_x,s.pos_y,s.pos_z,vi.item_template_id,t.buy_price,t.sell_price,ic.itemClassId FROM creature c JOIN spawnpool s ON s.creature_1_Id=c.id JOIN vendor_item vi ON vi.id=c.id JOIN itemtemplate t ON t.id=vi.item_template_id JOIN itemtemplate_itemclass ic ON ic.itemTemplateId=t.id WHERE c.id=73 AND s.id=116 AND vi.item_template_id=56

ordinary_training_day_checkpoint.read_only_query: SELECT i.item_id,i.item_template_id,i.stack_size FROM items i JOIN character_inventory c ON c.item_id=i.item_id WHERE c.character_id=1 AND i.item_template_id=56
ordinary_training_day_checkpoint.result: No template-56 stack in the copied character after ordinary Training Day turn-in; credits are 480. This no-kill diagnostic route does not represent every original player's loot history.

remaining_verification: Use the compatible client at Alia Das to buy template 56 from vendor 73, load or use it with Repair-O-Matic, and verify inventory and credit persistence in a copied database.
